messages:
jamal: FYI passing NoviCare to CS — quick context thread so we have a single source. Committed to Dedicated (monthly commitment), evaluating Private (on-prem) for HIPAA. Renewal in 11 months. Primary contact: sara@novicare.com. SLA ask + SOC2 in contract.

maria: thanks — logging details. Current state?: prod trial running, 3 routes, 1k req/day peak, latency sensitive. Any blockers I should know?

jamal: SSO not configured (IdP SAML) — customer expects SSO for go-live. Also wants on-prem checklist and an estimate for data residency. Eng already gave initial feasibility note but needs infra readiness runbook.

maria: noted. I'll start onboarding runbook and propose an enablement week. Who is owning SSO config and cert exchange?

oliver: I can own SSO intake and eng triage for private deploy. Need the customer's metadata file + test IdP. Also need their expected qps and peak seq length distribution for kernel selection.

jamal: they provided partial metadata, I'll DM the file. QPS ~50 sustained, spikes to 1k for short windows. Typical seq len 256.

rachel: I'll schedule a 1-hr enablement session (CS + Support + Eng) next Wed. Maria, does that work?

maria: works for me. Agenda: 1) SSO gap and timeline, 2) Private deployment readiness checklist, 3) test dataset + eval prompts, 4) escalation path.

jamal: risk level = medium-high for renewal unless SSO + Private timeline solidified. Customer mentioned procurement timeline tied to board approval in ~8 weeks.

maria: action items and owners: 
- Create onboarding runbook + customer-specific checklist -> maria (due in 3 business days)
- Open infra/ops ticket for private deploy readiness -> oliver (create ticket and tag @support)
- SSO exchange and test -> jamal + oliver (collect metadata by EOD tomorrow)
- Enablement session scheduling + invite -> rachel (invite sent by EOD)
- Provide sample prompt set and eval rubric -> maria (attach to ticket)

tess: I'll own the support-side triage and post-enable runbook. Once oliver opens the ticket, tag me and I'll add runbook steps for rollback and incident playbook.

oliver: creating ticket now — linking initial notes and resource links. Ticket ID: INF-9123. Contents: customer metadata placeholder, expected qps, seq len, compliance needs (SOC2/HIPAA).

jamal: @maria sending customer intro & procurement timeline. Also shared sample IdP JSON in dm — it's partial.

maria: got it. I'll mark missing fields and send a short template for IdP metadata to expedite.

rachel: invite sent for Wed 1400 PT. Calendar includes pre-read: onboarding checklist + infra FAQ.

maria: quick ask — can we get a demo key or staging endpoint for the customer for 2-week validation? Preferably with prefix caching enabled to simulate production.

oliver: we can provide staging with limited tokens. I'll provision a staging key and add quota. CLI for provisioning (internal):
```
redwood infra provision --project novi --env staging --quota 100k --prefix-cache on
```
I'll attach the output in INF-9123.

oncall-bot: Reminder: GDPR data handling doc link -> https://redwood.internal/docs/gdpr-processing (for CS + Eng review)

maria: noted. I'll include GDPR/HIPAA checklist in runbook.

tess: post-enable checklist items I'll add: logs access, runbook for cert rotation, quick escalation contacts (pager + slack), and sample observability queries for token/cost spikes.

jamal: go/no-go criteria for next sales checkpoint (8 weeks): SSO test pass, infra readiness signoff, procurement approval. If any of these miss the 6-week mark, flag renewal risk to Sales Ops.

maria: will track in our account tracker and set a 2-week cadence check-in. I'll post updates to this thread and link to tracker: https://redwood.internal/accounts/novicare 

rachel: support/eng pre-read posted to the invite. Please add any blockers to INF-9123 by EOD.

oliver: INF-9123 updated with staging key notes, provisioning steps, and customer metadata placeholder. Tagging @tess for runbook input.

tess: saw the ticket, adding runbook snippets now. Quick question: does customer need audit log export to their S3?

jamal: yes — they want daily export to their S3; procurement expects that in the contract. Add it to compliance checklist.

maria: added S3 export to runbook + owner (tess) and compliance note.

rachel: one more — capture feedback loop: after 2-week staging, we'll run an eval and capture quality/regression metrics. Maria, can you prepare 10 representative prompts and baseline expectations?

maria: will prepare prompt set and an eval rubric. Deliverable in 4 business days.

jamal: thanks all. I'll follow-up with the customer to confirm the IdP metadata timeline. If anyone sees procurement slip earlier than 6 weeks, ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll post a concise owner-summary later today for the exec brief.

oliver: tagging done. Closing notes in INF-9123.

oncall-bot: Deploy window notice — staging may be unavailable during infra maintenance tomorrow 0300-0400 PT. Planning accordingly.

maria: ok — noted and will warn customer about the maintenance window.

jamal: closing thread for now — please keep updates in INF-9123 and this thread for high-level context.

maria: copying final owner list here: Jamal (AE) -> procurement + IdP, Maria (CS) -> onboarding runbook + evals, Oliver (Eng) -> infra readiness + SSO triage + staging provisioning, Tess (Support) -> runbook + audit exports, Rachel (CS Ops) -> enablement scheduling.

tess: ack.

oliver: ack.
